item.title: FIFA Says Hackers Accessed Personal Data in Cyberattack
item.description: FIFA was targeted by a cyberattack that resulted in hackers accessing “personal and business information,” the football governing body said in a statement on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Isabel Demetz

item.title: QRT to Merge $2 Billion Hedge Fund With Flagship Qube Strategy
item.description: Qube Research & Technologies, one of the fastest growing investment firms in the world, is set to merge its crypto-focused money pool with its flagship hedge fund strategy.
item.dc:creator: Nishant Kumar

item.title: Africa’s Intra-Continental Trade Hit $213.8 Billion But Faces Payment Barriers
item.description: The value of trade between African nations rose about 6% last year to $213.8 billion, but accounted for only 14.6% of the continent’s total trade due to regional economic integration challenges, according to a study.
item.dc:creator: Fasika Tadesse

item.title: StanChart’s Crypto Custody Unit Suffers Data Breach
item.description: Standard Chartered’s crypto custody subsidiary Zodia Custody Ltd. said it had suffered a security breach, exposing some client and staff information.
item.dc:creator: Emily Nicolle

item.title: Netherlands Plans to Fight Rollout of Proposed US Curbs on ASML
item.description: The Dutch government said it will resist US plans to further restrict ASML Holding NV’s sales to China, calling the proposed rules a threat to Europe’s most valuable company.
item.dc:creator: Patrick Van Oosterom and Sarah Jacob
